_comment: wave 34 (tpose input_shape -> windowed trgeometry sequence accessors): a new FOUR-data-field aggregation shape that collects a window of (x, y, theta, ts) into a CONTINUOUS tpose sequence '[Pose(Point(x y),theta)@ts, ...]', parses it via tpose_in, converts it to a trgeometry via geo_tpose_to_trgeometry(refGeom, poseSeq) (the proven Nebula per-event path: a unit-square reference geometry), then applies a T**-returning trgeometry accessor f(temp, &_cnt) and brace-joins each element serialized via temporal_as_hexwkb(elem, 0x04 EWKB) — identical element loop to the tgeo seqarray fold (waves 31/32). Mirrors input_shape 'tgeo' but with 4 data fields and a 5-arg serde overload. Only the THREE T**-returning array accessors are emitted here. The three single-element accessors (trgeometry_sequence_n -> TSequence* with a scalar int arg, trgeometry_start_sequence / trgeometry_end_sequence -> TSequence*) return a SINGLE temporal, NOT a T** array with a &count out-param, so they cannot reuse the tposeseqarray &_cnt array form (which dereferences arr[_i] and reads _cnt); they need a dedicated 1-element finalize variant and are deferred.

operators.comment_one_liner: trgeometry_instants (TInstant **) - the array of instants of the windowed continuous trgeometry, each as EWKB hex.
trgeometry_segments (TSequence **) - the array of maximal segments of the windowed continuous trgeometry, each as EWKB hex.
trgeometry_sequences (TSequence **) - the array of sequences of the windowed continuous trgeometry, each as EWKB hex.
